publicationIdentifier_provider_shape_val.name: publicationIdentifier_provider_shape_valid
publicationIdentifier_provider_shape_val.value:
(
				("publicationIdentifier"."registrar" = 'crossref' AND "publicationIdentifier"."environment" IN ('test', 'production') AND "publicationIdentifier"."role" = 'primary')
				OR ("publicationIdentifier"."registrar" = 'zenodo' AND "publicationIdentifier"."environment" IN ('sandbox', 'production') AND "publicationIdentifier"."role" IN ('primary', 'version', 'concept'))
			)

publicationIdentifier_verified_bundle_va.name: publicationIdentifier_verified_bundle_valid
publicationIdentifier_verified_bundle_va.value:
(
				("publicationIdentifier"."lifecycle" = 'reserved' AND "publicationIdentifier"."verifiedAt" IS NULL)
				OR ("publicationIdentifier"."lifecycle" = 'verified' AND "publicationIdentifier"."verifiedAt" IS NOT NULL)
			)

publicationSyncJob_ready_idx.name: publicationSyncJob_ready_idx
publicationSyncJob_ready_idx.where: "publicationSyncJob"."processedAt" IS NULL AND "publicationSyncJob"."deadLetteredAt" IS NULL AND "publicationSyncJob"."supersededAt" IS NULL

publicationSyncJob_lease_bundle_valid.name: publicationSyncJob_lease_bundle_valid
publicationSyncJob_lease_bundle_valid.value:
(
				("publicationSyncJob"."leaseOwner" IS NULL AND "publicationSyncJob"."leaseExpiresAt" IS NULL)
				OR ("publicationSyncJob"."leaseOwner" IS NOT NULL AND "publicationSyncJob"."leaseExpiresAt" IS NOT NULL)
			)

publicationSyncJob_terminal_state_valid.name: publicationSyncJob_terminal_state_valid
publicationSyncJob_terminal_state_valid.value:
num_nonnulls("publicationSyncJob"."processedAt", "publicationSyncJob"."deadLetteredAt", "publicationSyncJob"."supersededAt") <= 1
				AND (num_nonnulls("publicationSyncJob"."processedAt", "publicationSyncJob"."deadLetteredAt", "publicationSyncJob"."supersededAt") = 0
					OR ("publicationSyncJob"."leaseOwner" IS NULL AND "publicationSyncJob"."leaseExpiresAt" IS NULL))

publicationSyncJob_receipt_bundle_valid.name: publicationSyncJob_receipt_bundle_valid
publicationSyncJob_receipt_bundle_valid.value:
("publicationSyncJob"."processedAt" IS NULL AND "publicationSyncJob"."resultReceipt" IS NULL)
				OR ("publicationSyncJob"."processedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "publicationSyncJob"."resultReceipt" IS NOT NULL)

publicationSyncRun_state_bundle_valid.name: publicationSyncRun_state_bundle_valid
publicationSyncRun_state_bundle_valid.value:
(
				("publicationSyncRun"."status" = 'running'
					AND "publicationSyncRun"."leaseOwner" IS NOT NULL
					AND "publicationSyncRun"."leaseExpiresAt" IS NOT NULL
					AND "publicationSyncRun"."heartbeatAt" IS NOT NULL
					AND "publicationSyncRun"."completedAt" IS NULL)
				OR ("publicationSyncRun"."status" IN ('succeeded', 'failed')
					AND "publicationSyncRun"."leaseOwner" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncRun"."leaseExpiresAt" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncRun"."completedAt" IS NOT NULL)
			)

publicationSyncRun_failure_valid.name: publicationSyncRun_failure_valid
publicationSyncRun_failure_valid.value:
("publicationSyncRun"."status" = 'failed' AND "publicationSyncRun"."failure" IS NOT NULL)
				OR ("publicationSyncRun"."status" <> 'failed' AND "publicationSyncRun"."failure" IS NULL)

publicationSyncState_provider_fields_val.name: publicationSyncState_provider_fields_valid
publicationSyncState_provider_fields_val.value:
(
				("publicationSyncState"."provider" = 'crossref'
					AND "publicationSyncState"."environment" IN ('test', 'production')
					AND "publicationSyncState"."identifierPolicy" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."lastFileManifestHash" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."lastFileManifestSnapshot" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."zenodoRecordId" IS NULL
                    AND "publicationSyncState"."unpublishedDraftDepositionId" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."zenodoParentId" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."zenodoVersionDoi" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."zenodoConceptDoi" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."zenodoFirstPublishedAt" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."orphanDraftDepositionId" IS NULL)
				OR ("publicationSyncState"."provider" = 'zenodo'
					AND "publicationSyncState"."environment" IN ('sandbox', 'production')
					AND "publicationSyncState"."identifierPolicy" IS NOT NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."identifierPolicy" IN ('reuse-crossref', 'reuse-external', 'mint-zenodo')
					AND "publicationSyncState"."pendingStage" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."pendingPayloadHash" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."pendingPayloadSnapshot" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."pendingBatchId" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."pendingFilename" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."pendingSubmittedAt" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."pendingReason" IS NULL)
			)

publicationSyncState_last_success_bundle.name: publicationSyncState_last_success_bundle_valid
publicationSyncState_last_success_bundle.value:
(
				("publicationSyncState"."lastPayloadHash" IS NULL AND "publicationSyncState"."lastPayloadSnapshot" IS NULL)
				OR ("publicationSyncState"."lastPayloadHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "publicationSyncState"."lastPayloadSnapshot" IS NOT NULL)
			)

publicationSyncState_file_bundle_valid.name: publicationSyncState_file_bundle_valid
publicationSyncState_file_bundle_valid.value:
(
				("publicationSyncState"."lastFileManifestHash" IS NULL AND "publicationSyncState"."lastFileManifestSnapshot" IS NULL)
				OR ("publicationSyncState"."lastFileManifestHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "publicationSyncState"."lastFileManifestSnapshot" IS NOT NULL)
			)

publicationSyncState_pending_bundle_vali.name: publicationSyncState_pending_bundle_valid
publicationSyncState_pending_bundle_vali.value:
(
				("publicationSyncState"."pendingStage" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."pendingPayloadHash" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."pendingPayloadSnapshot" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."pendingBatchId" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."pendingFilename" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."pendingSubmittedAt" IS NULL
					AND "publicationSyncState"."pendingReason" IS NULL)
				OR ("publicationSyncState"."pendingStage" IS NOT NULL AND "publicationSyncState"."pendingPayloadHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
			)

publicationSyncState_zenodo_identifiers_.name: publicationSyncState_zenodo_identifiers_bundle_valid
publicationSyncState_zenodo_identifiers_.value:
(
				("publicationSyncState"."zenodoRecordId" IS NULL AND "publicationSyncState"."zenodoParentId" IS NULL)
				OR ("publicationSyncState"."zenodoRecordId" IS NOT NULL AND "publicationSyncState"."zenodoParentId" IS NOT NULL)
			)

publicationSyncState_failure_bundle_vali.name: publicationSyncState_failure_bundle_valid
publicationSyncState_failure_bundle_vali.value:
(
				("publicationSyncState"."consecutiveFailures" = 0 AND "publicationSyncState"."lastFailureClass" IS NULL AND "publicationSyncState"."lastFailureSummary" IS NULL)
				OR ("publicationSyncState"."consecutiveFailures" > 0 AND "publicationSyncState"."lastFailureClass" IS NOT NULL AND "publicationSyncState"."lastFailureSummary" IS NOT NULL)
			)

publicationTarget_identifier_policy_vali.name: publicationTarget_identifier_policy_valid
publicationTarget_identifier_policy_vali.value:
(
				("publicationTarget"."provider" = 'crossref' AND "publicationTarget"."identifierPolicy" IS NULL)
				OR ("publicationTarget"."provider" = 'zenodo'
					AND "publicationTarget"."identifierPolicy" IS NOT NULL
					AND "publicationTarget"."identifierPolicy" IN ('reuse-crossref', 'reuse-external', 'mint-zenodo'))
			)

publicationTarget_external_doi_valid.name: publicationTarget_external_doi_valid
publicationTarget_external_doi_valid.value:
(
				("publicationTarget"."provider" = 'zenodo'
					AND "publicationTarget"."identifierPolicy" = 'reuse-external'
					AND "publicationTarget"."lockedExternalDoi" ~ '^10\.[0-9]{4,9}/[^[:space:]]{1,200}$'
					AND "publicationTarget"."lockedExternalDoi" = lower("publicationTarget"."lockedExternalDoi"))
				OR (NOT ("publicationTarget"."provider" = 'zenodo' AND "publicationTarget"."identifierPolicy" = 'reuse-external')
					AND "publicationTarget"."lockedExternalDoi" IS NULL)
			)

zenodoFileCorrectionApproval_terminal_st.name: zenodoFileCorrectionApproval_terminal_state_valid
zenodoFileCorrectionApproval_terminal_st.value:
num_nonnulls("zenodoFileCorrectionApproval"."consumedAt", "zenodoFileCorrectionApproval"."supersededAt") <= 1
				AND ("zenodoFileCorrectionApproval"."consumedAt" IS NULL OR "zenodoFileCorrectionApproval"."consumedAt" >= "zenodoFileCorrectionApproval"."approvedAt")
				AND ("zenodoFileCorrectionApproval"."supersededAt" IS NULL OR "zenodoFileCorrectionApproval"."supersededAt" >= "zenodoFileCorrectionApproval"."approvedAt")

zenodoPublishJournal_hashes_valid.name: zenodoPublishJournal_hashes_valid
zenodoPublishJournal_hashes_valid.value:
"zenodoPublishJournal"."payloadHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
				AND (("zenodoPublishJournal"."fileManifestHash" IS NULL AND "zenodoPublishJournal"."fileManifestSnapshot" IS NULL)
					OR ("zenodoPublishJournal"."fileManifestHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "zenodoPublishJournal"."fileManifestSnapshot" IS NOT NULL))

zenodoPublishJournal_file_correction_app.name: zenodoPublishJournal_file_correction_approval_valid
zenodoPublishJournal_file_correction_app.value:
(
				("zenodoPublishJournal"."operationType" = 'zenodo_file_update' AND "zenodoPublishJournal"."fileCorrectionApprovalId" IS NOT NULL)
				OR ("zenodoPublishJournal"."operationType" <> 'zenodo_file_update' AND "zenodoPublishJournal"."fileCorrectionApprovalId" IS NULL)
			)

zenodoPublishJournal_published_bundle_va.name: zenodoPublishJournal_published_bundle_valid
zenodoPublishJournal_published_bundle_va.value:
(
				("zenodoPublishJournal"."status" IN ('preparing', 'ready_to_publish')
					AND "zenodoPublishJournal"."publishedRecordId" IS NULL
					AND "zenodoPublishJournal"."identifiers" IS NULL
					AND "zenodoPublishJournal"."publishedAt" IS NULL)
				OR ("zenodoPublishJournal"."status" = 'published'
					AND "zenodoPublishJournal"."publishedRecordId" IS NOT NULL
					AND "zenodoPublishJournal"."identifiers" IS NOT NULL
					AND "zenodoPublishJournal"."publishedAt" IS NOT NULL)
			)

itemReview_resolution_valid.name: itemReview_resolution_valid
itemReview_resolution_valid.value: ("itemReview"."state" = 'pending' AND "itemReview"."resolvedAt" IS NULL AND "itemReview"."resolvedBy" IS NULL) OR ("itemReview"."state" <> 'pending' AND "itemReview"."resolvedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "itemReview"."resolvedBy" IS NOT NULL)

itemReviewFile_paths_match.name: itemReviewFile_paths_match
itemReviewFile_paths_match.value: ("itemReviewFile"."file" IS NULL AND "itemReviewFile"."objectPath" IS NULL AND "itemReviewFile"."coverObjectPath" IS NULL) OR ("itemReviewFile"."file" IS NOT NULL AND "itemReviewFile"."objectPath" IS NOT NULL AND "itemReviewFile"."coverObjectPath" IS NOT NULL AND "itemReviewFile"."file"->>'objectPath' = "itemReviewFile"."objectPath" AND "itemReviewFile"."file"->>'coverObjectPath' = "itemReviewFile"."coverObjectPath")

itemFileDraft_ready_bundle_consistent.name: itemFileDraft_ready_bundle_consistent
itemFileDraft_ready_bundle_consistent.value:
(
				(
					"itemFileDraft"."readyAt" IS NULL
					AND "itemFileDraft"."actualSizeBytes" IS NULL
					AND "itemFileDraft"."actualSha256" IS NULL
					AND "itemFileDraft"."extractedText" IS NULL
					AND "itemFileDraft"."coverObjectPath" IS NULL
					AND "itemFileDraft"."coverWidth" IS NULL
					AND "itemFileDraft"."coverHeight" IS NULL
					AND "itemFileDraft"."pageCount" IS NULL
				)
				OR (
					"itemFileDraft"."readyAt" IS NOT NULL
					AND "itemFileDraft"."actualSizeBytes" = "itemFileDraft"."expectedSizeBytes"
					AND "itemFileDraft"."actualSha256" = "itemFileDraft"."expectedSha256"
					AND "itemFileDraft"."extractedText" IS NOT NULL
					AND "itemFileDraft"."coverObjectPath" IS NOT NULL
					AND "itemFileDraft"."coverWidth" > 0
					AND "itemFileDraft"."coverHeight" > 0
					AND "itemFileDraft"."pageCount" > 0
				)
			)

outbox_dead_lettered_idx.name: outbox_dead_lettered_idx
outbox_dead_lettered_idx.where: "outbox"."processedAt" IS NULL AND "outbox"."deadLetteredAt" IS NOT NULL

outbox_lease_bundle_valid.name: outbox_lease_bundle_valid
outbox_lease_bundle_valid.value:
(
				("outbox"."leaseOwner" IS NULL AND "outbox"."leaseExpiresAt" IS NULL)
				OR ("outbox"."leaseOwner" IS NOT NULL AND "outbox"."leaseExpiresAt" IS NOT NULL)
			)

outbox_terminal_state_valid.name: outbox_terminal_state_valid
outbox_terminal_state_valid.value:
NOT ("outbox"."processedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "outbox"."deadLetteredAt" IS NOT NULL)
				AND ("outbox"."processedAt" IS NULL AND "outbox"."deadLetteredAt" IS NULL
					OR ("outbox"."leaseOwner" IS NULL AND "outbox"."leaseExpiresAt" IS NULL))

searchIndexWorker_progress_valid.name: searchIndexWorker_progress_valid
searchIndexWorker_progress_valid.value: "searchIndexWorker"."currentBatchProgress" IS NULL OR ("searchIndexWorker"."currentBatchUid" IS NOT NULL AND "searchIndexWorker"."currentTaskUid" IS NOT NULL AND "searchIndexWorker"."stage" = 'indexing' AND "searchIndexWorker"."currentBatchProgress" >= 0 AND "searchIndexWorker"."currentBatchProgress" <= 100)

searchIndexWorker_work_state_valid.name: searchIndexWorker_work_state_valid
searchIndexWorker_work_state_valid.value:
(
				("searchIndexWorker"."stage" IN ('starting', 'idle', 'retrying', 'stopping', 'stopped') AND "searchIndexWorker"."currentEventCount" = 0 AND "searchIndexWorker"."currentTaskUid" IS NULL AND "searchIndexWorker"."currentBatchUid" IS NULL AND "searchIndexWorker"."currentBatchProgress" IS NULL)
				OR ("searchIndexWorker"."stage" = 'projecting' AND "searchIndexWorker"."currentEventCount" > 0 AND "searchIndexWorker"."currentTaskUid" IS NULL AND "searchIndexWorker"."currentBatchUid" IS NULL AND "searchIndexWorker"."currentBatchProgress" IS NULL)
				OR ("searchIndexWorker"."stage" IN ('waiting', 'indexing') AND "searchIndexWorker"."currentEventCount" > 0 AND "searchIndexWorker"."currentTaskUid" IS NOT NULL)
			)

searchIndexWorker_stopped_state_valid.name: searchIndexWorker_stopped_state_valid
searchIndexWorker_stopped_state_valid.value: ("searchIndexWorker"."stage" = 'stopped' AND "searchIndexWorker"."stoppedAt" IS NOT NULL) OR ("searchIndexWorker"."stage" <> 'stopped' AND "searchIndexWorker"."stoppedAt" IS NULL)

sourceConnection_scope_valid.name: sourceConnection_scope_valid
sourceConnection_scope_valid.value:
(
				("sourceConnection"."provider" = 'native' AND "sourceConnection"."key" = 'native' AND "sourceConnection"."scopeKind" = 'library' AND "sourceConnection"."externalScopeKey" IS NULL)
				OR ("sourceConnection"."provider" = 'zotero' AND "sourceConnection"."scopeKind" IN ('group', 'personal-library') AND "sourceConnection"."externalScopeKey" IS NOT NULL)
				OR ("sourceConnection"."provider" = 'mendeley' AND "sourceConnection"."scopeKind" IN ('group', 'personal-library') AND "sourceConnection"."externalScopeKey" IS NOT NULL)
				OR ("sourceConnection"."provider" = 'openalex' AND "sourceConnection"."scopeKind" = 'query' AND "sourceConnection"."externalScopeKey" IS NULL)
				OR ("sourceConnection"."provider" = 'openscholar' AND "sourceConnection"."scopeKind" = 'collection' AND "sourceConnection"."externalScopeKey" IS NOT NULL)
				OR ("sourceConnection"."provider" = 'dspace' AND "sourceConnection"."scopeKind" IN ('repository', 'collection', 'oai-set') AND "sourceConnection"."externalScopeKey" IS NOT NULL)
				OR ("sourceConnection"."provider" = 'eprints' AND "sourceConnection"."scopeKind" IN ('repository', 'oai-set') AND "sourceConnection"."externalScopeKey" IS NOT NULL)
			)

sourceSyncRun_terminal_state_valid.name: sourceSyncRun_terminal_state_valid
sourceSyncRun_terminal_state_valid.value:
(
				("sourceSyncRun"."status" = 'running' AND "sourceSyncRun"."finishedAt" IS NULL AND "sourceSyncRun"."result" IS NULL AND "sourceSyncRun"."error" IS NULL)
				OR ("sourceSyncRun"."status" = 'succeeded' AND "sourceSyncRun"."finishedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "sourceSyncRun"."result" IS NOT NULL AND "sourceSyncRun"."error" IS NULL)
				OR ("sourceSyncRun"."status" = 'failed' AND "sourceSyncRun"."finishedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "sourceSyncRun"."result" IS NULL AND "sourceSyncRun"."error" IS NOT NULL)
			)

sourceSyncState_lease_bundle_valid.name: sourceSyncState_lease_bundle_valid
sourceSyncState_lease_bundle_valid.value:
(
				("sourceSyncState"."leaseOwner" IS NULL AND "sourceSyncState"."leaseExpiresAt" IS NULL AND "sourceSyncState"."activeRunId" IS NULL)
				OR ("sourceSyncState"."leaseOwner" IS NOT NULL AND "sourceSyncState"."leaseExpiresAt" IS NOT NULL AND "sourceSyncState"."activeRunId" IS NOT NULL)
			)

sourceWritebackJob_lease_bundle_valid.name: sourceWritebackJob_lease_bundle_valid
sourceWritebackJob_lease_bundle_valid.value:
(
				("sourceWritebackJob"."leaseOwner" IS NULL AND "sourceWritebackJob"."leaseExpiresAt" IS NULL)
				OR ("sourceWritebackJob"."leaseOwner" IS NOT NULL AND "sourceWritebackJob"."leaseExpiresAt" IS NOT NULL)
			)

sourceWritebackJob_terminal_state_valid.name: sourceWritebackJob_terminal_state_valid
sourceWritebackJob_terminal_state_valid.value:
NOT ("sourceWritebackJob"."processedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "sourceWritebackJob"."deadLetteredAt" IS NOT NULL)
				AND (NOT "sourceWritebackJob"."superseded" OR "sourceWritebackJob"."processedAt" IS NOT NULL)
				AND ("sourceWritebackJob"."processedAt" IS NULL AND "sourceWritebackJob"."deadLetteredAt" IS NULL
					OR ("sourceWritebackJob"."leaseOwner" IS NULL AND "sourceWritebackJob"."leaseExpiresAt" IS NULL))

itemCitationMetric_has_count.name: itemCitationMetric_has_count
itemCitationMetric_has_count.value: "itemCitationMetric"."citedByCount" IS NOT NULL OR "itemCitationMetric"."referencedWorksCount" IS NOT NULL
